typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblIntellimatchSnapshotdepartments_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Department as string,
		loaddate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Department as string,
		Loaddate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Department,
		Loaddate = loaddate),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblIntellimatchSnapshotdepartments_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblIntellimatchSnapshotdepartments
